title: 1976 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Fire Dragon
seo_title: 1976 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Fire Dragon (31 January – 17 February 1977)
description: 1976 is the Year of the Fire Dragon (Yang, Bing-chen), from 31 January 1976 to 17 February 1977. Personality, lucky colors and numbers, best matches, and what to know if you were born in January or February 1976.
lead: Born in 1976? Your Chinese zodiac animal is most likely the Dragon, but check the date: the 1976 Fire Dragon year began on 31 January 1976. Here is everything about the year, from its element to its lucky colors and best matches.
card_text: 1976: Year of the Fire Dragon, from 31 January 1976 to 17 February 1977.

image.caption: Illustration from MyBirthSign's zodiac artwork; it is not a photograph.

paras: The Chinese zodiac year 1976 was the Year of the Dragon. It began with Lunar New Year on 31 January 1976 and ended on 17 February 1977, the eve of the next Lunar New Year.

Each year also has an element and a Yin or Yang quality. 1976 ends in 6, which makes it a Fire year, and as an even year it is Yang. In the traditional stem-and-branch count, 1976 is a Bing-chen year. The same Fire Dragon combination comes round only once every 60 years: 1916 before it and 2036 after it.
Lunar New Year 1976 fell on 31 January 1976. Anyone born from 1 January 1976 up to the day before belongs to the previous year's animal, the Rabbit; from 31 January 1976 on, the Dragon.

The zodiac year starts at Lunar New Year, not on 1 January, which is why early-year birthdays need checking. Our guide Born in January? explains the rule, and the zodiac sign checker gives the exact answer for any birth date.

Our Dragon guide describes the sign like this: “Confident, charismatic, and ambitious. Dragons draw attention and often rise to leadership naturally.” The usual watch-out: “Can come across as proud or impatient with limitations.”

The Fire element adds its own flavour. Fire years bring passion, energy, and boldness. People of this element tend to be dynamic, adventurous, and quick to lead. Read more in our Fire element guide, or the full Year of the Dragon page.
Careers often linked with the Dragon: leadership, entrepreneurship, entertainment, real estate.

sections.h2: Best matches for someone born in 1976
paras: In traditional compatibility, the Dragon's best matches are the Rat, Monkey and Rooster, and its clash sign is the Dog, which sits directly opposite it on the zodiac circle. Our compatibility calculator compares two full birth dates, elements included.
2026 (Fire Horse, until 5 February 2027): for the Dragon, it has no special traditional relationship with the Horse, so 2026 is a neutral year.
2027 (Fire Goat, from 6 February 2027): for the Dragon, it has no special traditional relationship with the Goat, so 2027 is a neutral year. See Chinese zodiac 2027 predictions for every sign.

sections.h2: Other Year of the Dragon years
paras: Years of the same animal come every twelve years, each with a different element: 1952 (Water Dragon); 1964 (Wood Dragon); 1988 (Earth Dragon); 2000 (Metal Dragon). The full list is in our Chinese zodiac years chart.

faq: 1976 is the Year of the Dragon, a Yang Fire Dragon year (Bing-chen).
When does the 1976 Year of the Dragon start and end?
It starts on 31 January 1976 and ends on 17 February 1977.
I was born in January 1976. What is my Chinese zodiac?
If you were born before 31 January 1976, you are a Rabbit; from 31 January 1976 on, a Dragon.
Fire. 1976 ends in 6, which belongs to Fire, and it is a Yang year.
Who is the Dragon compatible with?
Traditionally the Rat, Monkey and Rooster. The Dragon's clash sign is the Dog.
